description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from a prostate cancer radiotherapy clinical registry, covering demographics, treatment plan, delivery events, adverse effects, and follow-up outcomes.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual registry record or observation.

encounter_id.descr: Unique identifier for the treatment session, follow-up visit, or registry event.

sex.descr: Biological sex at birth; expected values include male, female, intersex, or unknown.

ethnicity.descr: Self-reported ethnicity using a controlled vocabulary when possible.

race.descr: Self-reported race using a controlled vocabulary when applicable.

body_mass_index_kg_m2.descr: Body mass index at baseline in kg/m^2.

smoking_status.descr: Smoking status at baseline; e.g., never, former, current, unknown.

comorbidities.descr: Comorbidity list or coded summary at baseline, such as diabetes, hypertension, cardiovascular disease, COPD.

charlson_comorbidity_index.descr: Charlson Comorbidity Index score at baseline.

performance_status.descr: Baseline functional status, e.g., ECOG or Karnofsky score, specify scale in accompanying documentation.

prostate_cancer_stage.descr: Clinical or pathological stage at the time of registry entry, using TNM or equivalent staging.

gleason_score.descr: Gleason score or Grade Group at diagnosis.

psa_ng_ml.descr: Prostate-specific antigen value in ng/mL near diagnosis or treatment baseline.

risk_group.descr: Clinical risk category, such as low, intermediate, high, very high, or metastatic.

radiotherapy_intent.descr: Treatment intent; e.g., curative, adjuvant, salvage, palliative.

radiotherapy_technique.descr: Radiotherapy technique used; e.g., 3D-CRT, IMRT, VMAT, SBRT, proton therapy.

treatment_protocol_name.descr: Name or code of the radiotherapy protocol or regimen.

target_volume_type.descr: Target volume definition; e.g., prostate, prostate bed, seminal vesicles, pelvic nodes.

target_volume_description.descr: Free-text or coded description of the treated target volume and margins.

target_volume_volume_cc.descr: Target volume size in cubic centimeters (cc), if available.

prescribed_dose_gy.descr: Total prescribed radiation dose in Gray (Gy).

dose_per_fraction_gy.descr: Dose delivered per fraction in Gray (Gy).

fractionation_schedule.descr: Fractionation pattern, such as conventional, moderate hypofractionation, ultrahypofractionation, or boost schedule.

planned_total_treatment_days.descr: Planned number of treatment days for the course.

session_date.descr: Date of the individual radiotherapy session or event.

session_number.descr: Sequential number of the treatment session within the course.

session_attended.descr: Whether the patient attended the planned treatment session.

session_completed.descr: Whether the session was completed as planned.

session_interruption_reason.descr: Reason for missed or interrupted session, if applicable.

on_treatment_modification.descr: Whether the treatment plan was modified during the course.

modification_description.descr: Description of any plan adaptation, dose change, or target revision.

concurrent_systemic_therapy.descr: Whether concurrent systemic therapy was given during radiotherapy.

concurrent_therapy_type.descr: Type of concurrent therapy, such as androgen deprivation therapy, chemotherapy, or other.

adverse_event_present.descr: Whether an adverse reaction or toxicity was recorded for the record.

adverse_event_type.descr: Type of adverse event, such as gastrointestinal, genitourinary, dermatologic, fatigue, or sexual dysfunction.

adverse_event_grade.descr: Severity grade of the adverse event, typically CTCAE grade 1 to 5.

adverse_event_resolution_date.descr: Date the adverse event resolved, if known.

follow_up_time_months.descr: Time from treatment start or end to follow-up in months; define anchor consistently in the dataset.

disease_status_at_follow_up.descr: Disease status at follow-up; e.g., no evidence of disease, biochemical recurrence, local recurrence, metastasis, deceased, unknown.

psa_follow_up_ng_ml.descr: PSA value at follow-up in ng/mL.

overall_survival_status.descr: Vital status at follow-up; e.g., alive, dead, lost to follow-up.

cause_of_death.descr: Recorded cause of death, if known.

quality_of_life_instrument.descr: Name of the quality-of-life instrument used, such as EPIC, EORTC QLQ-C30, or SF-36.

quality_of_life_score.descr: Summary quality-of-life score from the selected instrument, if applicable.

quality_of_life_domain.descr: Specific domain assessed, such as urinary, bowel, sexual, hormonal, physical, emotional, or global health.

last_contact_date.descr: Date of last known contact or registry update.

lost_to_follow_up.descr: Whether the patient was lost to follow-up.

data_source.descr: Origin of the record, such as EHR, registry abstraction, treatment planning system, or patient-reported outcome form.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the record.
